context_title: An ultra‑realistic studio portrait photo of a young, pale‑skinned boy with platinum‑white, short, textured hair, slightly messy and voluminous on top, with a tight fade on the sides that reveals darker roots. His head is held perfectly straight and upright, facing the camera directly in a symmetrical composition, against a completely solid, pitch‑black background with nothing else in the frame. Hyper‑detailed facial anatomy with PBR skin: visible pores, fine vellus hairs, natural skin oils creating soft specular highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, and cheekbones. Deep, expressive almond‑shaped brown eyes with visible iris striations and sharp catchlights from the studio lighting, subtle dark shadows beneath the lower eyelids, and thick, dark, naturally arched eyebrows contrasting with the white hair. A prominent, straight nose with a slightly rounded tip and a hint of redness around the nasal folds. Full, naturally textured lips, slightly parted, with the bottom edges of the upper teeth just visible, and a light, patchy dark stubble on the upper lip, chin and defined jawline. Dramatic, high‑contrast studio key lighting with subtle rim light that crisply separates the silhouette from the black void. Frontal studio portrait, straight neck alignment, 8K resolution look, RAW‑style rendering, shot as if on a Sony A7R IV with an 85mm portrait lens at f/2.0, subsurface scattering, ray‑traced lighting, cinematic color grading, hyper‑photorealistic, ultra‑detailed, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio
